subject: Post-sign MAP: governance, onboarding timeline & roles
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-sign MAP: governance, onboarding timeline & roles

Hi Emily and Tom —

Thanks again for signing the SOW yesterday — excited to get Pathway Health into production. As discussed in the close call, attached is a first-pass activation checklist and the mutual action plan (MAP) draft. This thread is intended to formally kick off ownership and align stakeholders so we have a shared timeline to QA and pilot the first integration.

High-level goals for the next 6 weeks:
- Week 1 (Mar 13–17): Kickoff, access provisioning, security questionnaire handoff
- Weeks 2–3 (Mar 20–31): Integration work (API keys, endpoint mapping), initial eval prompts
- Week 4 (Apr 3–7): Pilot evaluation, quality checks, regressions
- Week 5–6 (Apr 10–21): Final adjustments, production cutover checklist and go/no-go

Please review the attached MAP_Activation_Checklist_v1.xlsx (tabbed for roles, milestones, and acceptance criteria). Action items for this thread:
1) Emily — confirm primary Pathway stakeholders and point of contact for security (name + email).
2) Tom — can your IT team provide the list of IPs/nat ranges for allowlist and preferred VPN window?
3) Rishi / Grace — we'll coordinate CS handoff and proposed weekly touchpoints (30 min) during the pilot.

I'll loop in Marcus for credits or escalation policy if needed. If that timeline looks broadly feasible, Emily — can you confirm the stakeholder roster and any blackout dates by EOD Monday?

Thanks,

Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0126

Hi all — looping in Customer Success for the formal handoff. Thanks Emily for confirming stakeholders and the preferred kickoff window. A few notes from CS and proposed operational cadence: 

- Primary CS owner: Grace Oconnor (Customer Success, Redwood) — grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
- Secondary CS lead (technical): Rishi Malhotra (Solution Architect) — will drive the integration calls and eval prompts

Proposed 6-week playbook (concrete deliverables):
Week 1: Kickoff + access checklist completed (we'll capture signoffs in the MAP spreadsheet)
Week 2: Integration sprint 1 — baseline inference tests + logging configured (we'll send a baseline metrics template)
Week 3: Eval run 1 — clinical prompt set (Pathway provides), Redwood provides scoring rubric and automated eval script
Week 4: Iteration on prompts and quality tuning (2 cycles max unless otherwise agreed)
Week 5: Pilot run and production readiness review (data retention & audit log review)
Week 6: Final acceptance, go/no-go and 30-day stabilization plan

Meeting cadence: 30-min standups weekly; Rishi and Emily will trade action-item owners after each meeting. For any blockers that risk >1 week delay, we escalate to Marcus Lin (cc).

Action items for this email: 
- Emily: confirm clinical prompt set delivery date (you mentioned 'end of next week' in the kickoff call)
- Tom / IT: share the allowlist IPs and any proxy requirements before Wed Mar 15
- Olga: please confirm SLA expectations (latency targets) for the pilot; we'll map to the Dedicated capacity plan if needed

I'll create a shared MAP workbook (Drive link below) and populate Week 1 tasks by EOD.

Grace Oconnor
